Upgrading multi-master #PostgreSQL with no spare servers? Ahsan Hadi & Susan Douglas walk through pg_upgrade --link (Postgres's upgrade tool) in place, one node at a time, while the rest stay writable.

In a 17 to 18 test, the upgraded node looked healthy to its peers but applied none of their changes. pg_upgrade doesn't keep something Spock (pgEdge's #OpenSource replication extension) needs.

What it is & the fix are in the post. 👉 https://www.pgedge.com/blog/zero-downtime-in-place-major-postgresql-upgrades-on-a-distributed-postgresql-cluster
